svg.title: Performance feedback loop — decision logic
svg.desc: Vertical logic diagram of the performance feedback loop: two entry points write to user_action_log; a five-day hold-off guards compute_outcomes; _determine_hit scores the action direction against forward price returns; one drv_rule_outcome row per triggered rule is written; v_rule_performance_window aggregates per rule; the Performance screen surfaces hit rate and avg return so weak rules can be edited.

g.text: Two entry points — user saves a decision
Cockpit POST /api/actions — meta-code ACTED or SKIP resolved to scorable action_code
Actionable POST /api/actions/{symbol} — explicit DONE / SKIPPED / SNOOZED / OVERRIDDEN
Both paths snapshot triggered_rules (JSONB array of {rule_id, kind}) from drv_stks at call time
user_action_log — forensic snapshot row
action_code · user_action · triggered_rules JSONB · source_actions JSONB
drv_actionable snapshot · hist_* raw snapshot per ref_outlook_source
Nightly scheduler — hold-off guard
compute_outcomes runs at outcomes_compute_hour (default 22) via etl/scheduler.py
selects rows where as_of_date <= CURRENT_DATE − 5 days and not yet in drv_rule_outcome · batch 1 000
_get_forward_return — price lookup
start price = drv_ma.last_price on as_of_date · end price = drv_ma.last_price N trading days later
N trading days found via MAX(snapshot_date) FROM drv_ma WHERE snapshot_date > start LIMIT N
_determine_hit — direction scoring
thresholds from ref_settings (outcome_hit_threshold_buy/sell, outcome_hold_threshold)
sell-direction (SA, STM, SS, REMOVE, REDUCE): hit when fwd_5d <= sell threshold (default −0.5 %)
buy-direction (BM, ADD, INCREASE): hit when fwd_5d >= buy threshold (default +0.5 %)
neutral (HOLD, SKIP): hit when |fwd_5d| < hold threshold (default 1.0 %) · ACTED: |move| >= min threshold
drv_rule_outcome — one row per triggered rule per decision
PK (rule_id, as_of_date, symbol) · fwd_5d_pct · fwd_20d_pct · hit flag
ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE — idempotent; delete all rows to force full rescore
v_rule_performance_window(p_window_days, p_from, p_to)
groups drv_rule_outcome by rule_id / rule_kind within the requested date window
outputs: sample_size · hit_rate · false_positive_rate · avg + median fwd_5d / fwd_20d · first/last_seen
v_rule_performance view = fixed 180-day alias kept for backward compat
Performance screen — /rule-performance
GET /api/rules/performance · sortable table · findings drive edits on the Rules screen
